verses.text: Come near, you nations, and listen! Pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth and everything in it hear, the world and everything that comes from it.
For the LORD is angry with all the nations, and furious with all their armies. He will completely destroy them. He will hand them over to be killed.
Their dead will be thrown out, and the smell of their bodies will rise. The mountains will be soaked with their blood.
All the stars in the sky will melt away, and the sky will be rolled up like a scroll. All its stars will fall like withered leaves from a vine, like shriveled figs from a fig tree.
My sword has finished its work in the heavens. Look, now it will come down on Edom, the people I have set apart for destruction, to judge them.

The sword of the LORD is covered with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat from the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
Wild oxen will fall with them, young bulls along with strong bulls. Their land will be soaked with blood, and their dust will be greasy with fat.
For the LORD has a day of paying back, a year of repaying the wrongs done to Zion.
Edom's streams will be turned into tar, its dust into burning sulfur. Its land will become burning tar.
It will not be put out, day or night. Its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie in ruins. No one will ever travel through it again.
Desert owls and porcupines will take it over. Great owls and ravens will live there. God will measure it out for confusion and emptiness, like a builder using a measuring line and a level.
Its nobles will have nothing left there to call a kingdom. All its leaders will be gone.
Thorns will grow over its palaces, and nettles and thistles over its forts. It will become a home for jackals, a place for owls.
Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and wild goats will call to one another. The night creatures will rest there and find themselves a place to stay.
Owls will make their nests there. They will lay eggs, hatch them, and gather their young under their wings. Falcons will gather there too, each with its mate.

Look in the book of the LORD and read it: not one of these creatures will be missing. Not one will be without its mate. For the LORD has commanded it with his mouth, and his Spirit will gather them together.
He has divided the land among them. He has measured out their portions with his hand. They will own it forever and live there from generation to generation.
